ling-concept.png.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Chinese research newsletter inline explanatory image, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: Explain hybrid attention conceptually with a visual metaphor, not a product screenshot or benchmark. A horizontal stream of six small paper slips each containing a different simple symbol flows into two clearly distinguished paths. Upper path: a compact evolving notebook condenses information from earlier slips, with a subtle visible loss of detail; lower path: a desk with the original slips preserved in sequence, showing direct pairwise relationships via thin threads. Both paths contribute to a final single output slip on the right. Use an elegant editorial cut-paper illustration on warm off-white, muted teal and dark blue, high contrast and generous spacing.
Text exactly: title "两种记忆方式，交替工作"; upper label "压缩历史状态"; lower label "读取完整上下文"; footer "概念示意 · 不代表层数或性能". No other text, logos, numbers, metrics or fake screens. Chinese labels must be legible.
Constraints: Mechanism metaphor for Ling-3.1-flash's hybrid linear attention and gated MLA. Do not suggest data disappear from the actual context, do not show sequential layers or an exact architecture, no speed claims, no invented results. The notebook is a metaphor for a bounded summary state. Clear arrows toward the output, no decorative logo.
